notes.title: Alpha #3 Update Available
notes.notes:
[h1]Attention to all DRIVES and SHOOTERS[/h1]

[h1]The latest update is featuring new tracks, new vehicles and turrets[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b]INCREASED LEVEL CAP[/b] to 3, featuring the rail and hover turret and new race tracks with shootable short-cut gates.
 [*][b]NEW VEHICLES[/b] - the Matador Heavy Truck and Maurador Trophy Truck are available. Both vehicles are bold and heavy compared to the more leightweight Kloss and Buggy.
 [*][b]NEW INGAME COMMUNICATION PANEL[/b] for enhanced team coms.
 [*][b]NEW WEAPON[/b]: Introducing ''The Health Gun',  Shooters can infuse Health to Drivers.
 [*][b]CLAN FEATURE[/b] preview: each pair of players can assign a TEAM NAME and LOGO, from there team points will be accumulated for this team and can be ranked on the global TEAM leaderboard.
(Hint: Choose the ALIENWARE team to get access to the ALIENWARE branded buggy)
[/list]

See you on the race tracks!

notes.title: Hot Fix Update 2
notes.notes:
Build Version 2014.03.27 #1:
- fixed crash bugs, epecially while loading and in situations when player leave the match during gameplay
- fixed killed messages, now you will see who has killed you more consistently
- slightly lower sniper power
- DRM signed
